answer:
The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

The category has two pages. Page 1 had three five-star books, and the cheapest was £25.37. Page 2 had two: The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) at £23.05 and The Girl You Lost at £12.29. I left page 2 open in the browser tab.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; agent-browser --session $S eval 'Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("article.product_pod")).map(a=>a.querySelector("p.star-rating").className+"|"+a.querySelector("h3 a").title+"|"+a.querySelector(".price_color").innerText).join("\n")+"\n"+(document.querySelector(".pager .current")||{}).innerText'
